name: A Cry for Help
source:
You don’t understand!! I NEED this package! Please…I…I have been looking forward to it for a week now! If I don’t get it then…my life is over.”

Being a call center agent had its ups and downs. The ups? Pretty decent benefits, good pay, sitting around, okay coworkers.

The downs? People constantly being in your ear, Karen’s, the typical downside of customer service.

But…then you get a phone call that everyone was warning you about and making sure you were well prepared for: a crisis call.

A very desperate man needs his package, and he needs it soon.

[From [url=https://itsyaboi328.itch.io/acryforhelpvn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「你根本不明白！我非拿到這個包裹不可！求求你……我……我已經盼了整整一週了！要是拿不到它……我的人生就完了。」

在客服中心當客服，有好處，也有壞處。好處呢？福利不錯，薪水不低，可以坐著上班，同事也還過得去。

壞處呢？耳邊總有人說個不停，難纏的顧客，還有客服行業常見的那些煩心事。

但……接下來，你接到了一通所有人都提醒你務必做好準備的電話：危機求助電話。

一個絕望至極的男人急需拿到他的包裹，而且刻不容緩。

[摘自[url=https://itsyaboi328.itch.io/acryforhelpvn]Itch.io[/url]]
